profile.description: Vox is a news and opinion channel that aims to explain complex issues and make sense of the world. The channel produces videos on a wide range of topics, including politics, economics, science, and culture, often taking a deep dive into current events and providing context and analysis. The channel also features interviews and discussions with experts and thought leaders.
profile.niche: Explanatory journalism and in-depth analysis of current events and complex issues.
profile.intent: To inform and educate viewers by providing context, analysis, and different perspectives on a variety of topics, encouraging critical thinking and a deeper understanding of the world.

Social Issues & Cultural Trends: impact of social media on society
